prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1036; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a report of a low-speed collision in a retail parking lot. Insured reports the other vehicle backed into the insured's rear bumper while the insured was stopped. Police were not called. Photos of both vehicles obtained from insured and stored in file.

Entry 2: Claimant has a knee injury and has retained counsel, who has sent a letter of representation. All further contact to go through the attorney's office. Requested medical authorization and prior treatment records for the knee.

Entry 3: Recorded statement taken from the insured. Insured confirms speed was minimal and no contact occurred before the impact. Witness in the adjacent space was not identified. Notes to follow up with store security for any lot camera footage.

Entry 4: Received an itemized medical summary from claimant's counsel covering initial evaluation and imaging of the knee. Reviewing for relationship to the reported impact and checking for any prior knee complaints in available records. Referred file to the medical review unit.

Entry 5: Spoke with claimant's attorney regarding the pending medical review. Attorney requested a status update and indicated a settlement demand will follow once treatment is complete. Advised that liability is still under review and that the file will remain open pending the medical review outcome.
